info.title: Space / Drive API contracts
info.description:
Transcription of `Helpers/Drive-API-contracts 2.pdf` (11 November 2026).

File calls are used by Drive and the website. People, invite, and admin calls are the website only.
Workspace-scoped website calls also send header `X-Workspace-Id`.

The PDF names methods, paths, request fields, and response shapes. It names some HTTP statuses (201 create node, 204 deletes, 410 direct user create, 403 invite account mismatch, 502 invite resend mail failure, 409 admin delete while owning a workspace). Where the PDF is silent, success responses below use 200 for bodies and 204 for empty bodies.

Identifiers in the PDF examples are UUIDs (users, workspaces, namespaces, nodes, app tokens, dispatches). Project/group ids are integers. Invite tokens are 64 hex characters.

Authentication: `POST /login` and `POST /login/2fa` are anonymous. `GET /invites/{token}` and invite logo/inviter image routes are public. Other routes use `Authorization: Bearer`. Drive issues an app token via `POST /me/apps/tokens` after sign-in and uses that token afterward. `expiresAt` is 12 hours; `pairingExpiresAt` is 90 days.

This file does not replace `openapi/v1/openapi.json` or `openapi/v1/drive.openapi.json`.

post.summary: Sign in with user name and password.

200.description: LoginSuccess, or TwoFactorChallenge when a second factor is required.

post.summary: Complete sign-in with a two-factor code.
Issue an app token for this computer.

200.description: Issued app token. expiresAt is 12 hours; pairingExpiresAt is 90 days.

post.description: Authorized by the bearer app token being refreshed.

200.description: New IssuedAppToken. Client replaces the stored token.
Renamed StorageNode. Sync log gets rename.

204.description: Trashed. Sets trashedAt. Sync log gets trash.

get.summary: List children of a storage node.
List storage changes for a namespace.
get.description: Sync log. Server sends up to 500 newer rows. Drive treats trash, delete, and purge as remove-from-Finder; other ops as refresh.

201.description: Created StorageNode. Sync log gets create.

post.summary: Move a storage node under another parent.

200.description: Moved StorageNode. Sync log gets move.

put.summary: Replace the bytes of a storage node.

requestBody.description: Raw file bytes. Content-Type is the file's type, such as application/pdf.

200.description: Updated StorageNode with new byteSize and contentHash. Sync log gets content.

get.summary: Download the bytes of a storage node.

200.description: File bytes. Includes Content-Type, Content-Length, and Content-Disposition.

get.summary: Open info for a storage node.

200.description: Scene returns spaceUrl and href. Ordinary file returns download.

post.summary: Dispatch storage nodes as a shareable copy.
post.description: Accept must be application/x-ndjson. Response is an NDJSON stream of DispatchEvent (start, progress, done, or error). Public page is /d/{publicId}.

post.summary: Email a notification for a dispatch.

get.summary: List people in the current workspace.
Get the signed-in person in the current workspace.

patch.summary: Update a member's role, permission code, or startup scene.

delete.summary: Remove a member from the workspace.
delete.description: Account and My Drive stay. Cannot remove self. Personal folders inside this workspace go away.

put.summary: Replace a member's project access list.

200.description: Updated access. Projects left off are taken away.

post.description: Invite lasts 7 days. A previous pending invite for the same email is revoked. Token in the link is 64 hex characters.
Moves expiry 7 days forward. If mail fails, status is 502 and the link is still in the answer.

502.description: Mail failed; invite link still returned.

get.summary: List invites waiting for the signed-in person.
get.description: Matched by email. No workspace header.

get.summary: Workspace logo for the invite page.
Inviter avatar for the invite page.

post.description: New accounts must send username and password. Existing accounts must be signed in as the invited email; body may be empty. Wrong signed-in user returns 403 with accountMismatch.

403.description: Signed in as the wrong person.

get.summary: List members and available people for a project.

204.description: Added. Users must already belong to the workspace.

delete.summary: Remove one person from a project.

204.description: Removed. Personal folder under that project goes away.

200.description: Account deleted. Sign-in token stops working.

patch.summary: Update app flags and Drive quota.

delete.summary: Delete an account as platform administrator.
delete.description: No email code. 409 if the account still owns a workspace. Administrator cannot delete self.

bearerAuth.description: Login token or issued app token. Not used by POST /login, POST /login/2fa, or public invite preview/image routes.

WorkspaceIdHeader.name: X-Workspace-Id
WorkspaceIdHeader.description: Current workspace id. Required on website workspace-scoped people and group calls.

DispatchId.name: id
DispatchId.description: Dispatch id from the start event (not publicId).

driveQuotaBytes.description: Default for a new account is 5368709120 (5 GB).

AuthWorkspace.description: Workspace membership summary on sign-in / invite accept.

pairingExpiresAt.description: 90 days from issue. Pairing call is not defined in the PDF.

StorageNode.description: File or folder record. Full field set appears on GET by id; list/children examples may return a subset.

name.description: Optional new name. Drive sends only parentId.

download.description: Download URL for ordinary files; null for scenes.

DispatchEvent.description: One NDJSON line. event is start, progress, done, or error. Fields vary by event.

delivered.description: False when mail is not configured; the link is still ready.

rolePreset.description: Lowercase role, or null for a custom mix.

UpdateWorkspaceMemberRequest.description: Changes role, permission code, or startup scene. Does not change name, email, or password.

groupId.description: Required unless the invite is for an Owner.

AcceptInviteRequest.description: Required for a new account. May be empty when the invited account already exists and is signed in.

UpdateAdminUserRequest.description: Body must include all three app flags and the quota. Drive itself stays on.
